subTitle:
من ذو بدايت العام، بعد كسر منطقة دعم محورية وسط موجة تراجعات تضرب سوق العملات الرقمية بالكامل بقيادة البيتكوين.  
​1. التحليل الفني وحركة السعر
​الاتجاه العام: هبوطي واضح على المدى القصير والمتوسط؛ فقد السعر خلال الأسبوع الماضي نحو 15.6% من قيمته، وخلال الشهر الماضي قرابة 26.5%.  
​كسر الدعوم: أدى كسر منطقة الطلب السابقة عند 1,900 – 1,980 دولار إلى تسارع وتيرة البيع وتصفية المراكز الشرائية وصولاً إلى قاع يومي عند 1,711 دولاراً قبل أن يظهر ارتداد شرائي طفيف.  
​مؤشرات الزخم (RSI): يقبع مؤشر القوة النسبية (RSI) على الإطار اليومي قرب مستوى 25، مما يضع العملة في منطقة تشبع بيعي (Oversold) حادة. فنياً، هذا يرفع احتمالية حدوث ارتداد تصحيحي صاعد لتخفيف الضغط، لكنه لا يعني بالضرورة انتهاء الهبوط وتشكيل قاع نهائي.  
. العوامل الأساسية ومعنويات السوق
​ارتباط السوق وتدفقات الصناديق: يتأثر الإيثريوم بشكل مباشر بتراجع البيتكوين نحو مستويات 60,000 دولار وتصاعد عمليات التصفية في السوق. ورغم تسجيل صناديق الإيثريوم الفورية (Spot ETH ETFs) تدفقات داخلة طفيفة (~2.36 مليون دولار) مقارنة بخروج السيولة من صناديق البيتكوين، إلا أن شهية المخاطرة العامة لا تزال ضعيفة.  
​توقعات المتداولين: تشير أسواق التوقعات (مثل Kalshi) إلى ترجيح اختبار مستويات قرب 1,760 دولاراً كقاع لشهر نوفمبر، مع ترقب حذر لاحتمالية كسرها نحو 1,500 دولار إذا استمرت الضغوط البيعية.  
​الخلاصة والاستراتيجية المقترحة

translatedData.content:
【ETH’s moat isn’t faster transactions】

The Fear & Greed Index fell to 10. ETH dropped 18.1% in a week. The market isn’t afraid of a pullback—it’s asking whether ETH is still worth holding as scaling gets faster.

Think of Ethereum as a highway’s main toll plaza. Rollups process transactions in batches on the side, then send the results and proofs back to the mainnet. This cuts costs and eases congestion, but secure settlement still depends on ETH.

That means you can’t evaluate ETH by looking only at TPS. You need to ask who pays the fees, who needs settlement, and whether value can flow back to the mainnet. Talking only about speed is like a shovel seller announcing they’ve struck gold.

MegaETH laid off 20% of its staff to pivot to AI, while DeFi TVL fell from over $245 million to $8.8 million. The direction may not be wrong, but the numbers are already there: technology that works doesn’t guarantee users will stay, and a scale built on subsidies doesn’t equal genuine commercial demand.

In practice, scaling chains, DeFi applications, and ETH stakers will all be affected: less use of applications means weaker settlement demand; stronger mainnet demand makes ETH’s security budget more robust. The business model has to work: scaling must send the added value back to ETH’s settlement layer, rather than building a separate, closed-loop system.

Remember: ETH’s value isn’t determined by how fast the chain is, but by how much real economic activity ultimately needs to settle in ETH.

In the next round of competition, what do you think matters more: technological speed or a complete business model?

#ETH #加密分析 #IMD #Market Insights

content:
【ETH的护城河，不是更快的转账】

恐惧贪婪指数跌到10。ETH一周跌18.1%。市场怕的不是回调，而是扩容越快，ETH还值不值得持有。

把以太坊想成高速主收费站。Rollup在旁边批量处理交易，再把结果和证明交回主网。它省成本、降拥堵，但安全结算仍依赖ETH。

这意味着，评估ETH不能只看TPS，要看谁付手续费、谁需要结算、收益能否回到主网。只讲速度，就像卖铲子的人先宣布自己挖到金矿。

MegaETH裁员20%转向AI，DeFi TVL从超过2.45亿美元降至880万美元。方向未必错，但账已经摆出来：技术能跑不等于用户会留下，补贴撑起的规模不等于真实商业需求。

落到实处，扩容链、DeFi应用和ETH质押者都会受影响：应用少用，结算需求就弱；主网需求强，ETH的安全预算才更扎实。商业逻辑必须成立：扩容把新增价值送回ETH结算层，而不是自己另起一套闭环。

记住：ETH的价值不由“链有多快”决定，而由多少真实经济活动最终需要ETH结算。

下一轮竞争，你觉得技术速度更重要，还是商业闭环更重要？

ETH upgrade risk enters review period | Glamsterdam testnet still awaiting rescheduling | Watch support at $1,830 first

My stance is cautious and leaning toward waiting. I would not treat the upgrade timeline as a short-term bullish catalyst. On November 6, the Ethereum Foundation said that EIP-8037 and EIP-8038, part of the Glamsterdam upgrade currently under testing, change some operational and state-charging mechanisms. Auditors found that certain deployed contracts relying on old invariants could run into problems under the new rules. Core developers therefore postponed the Hoodi testnet fork, canceling the activation originally scheduled for October 26. No new date has been set. In a November 9 update, the Foundation said it had received reports of four deployed contracts that may be affected and is reviewing them individually. It plans to publicly discuss the audit findings at the November 16 developers’ meeting and discuss next steps on November 19. These meeting dates are agenda items, not confirmation that the upgrade will proceed.

The impact on ETH is currently about expectations and ecosystem risk, not on-chain parameters already changing today. If the new gas pricing rules break assumptions made by non-upgradeable contracts, developers may need to revise the EIPs or give applications more time to migrate. If the review confirms that the impact is manageable, the testnet timeline may then be able to move forward again. The more prudent approach is to first clarify the scope of the issue, then discuss scaling benefits and fee changes. The Foundation’s announcement explicitly said this delay applies to the Hoodi testnet. It did not announce a mainnet activation date or ask regular mainnet ETH holders to take any action. So I won’t say “the mainnet upgrade has failed,” nor infer from this that ETH will automatically become deflationary or fees will immediately fall.

The Plaza trending list is currently focused on liquidations, XRP ETF flows, and profitable BTC holders, while ETH remains among the six-hour trending searches. Glamsterdam itself is not listed as a trending tag on the page, so this article is tagged only with the asset. On the macro front, the Fed’s upcoming minutes have not yet been released, and there are no new ETF flow figures for the weekend, when markets are closed. Pricing in events that have not yet happened can distort a trading plan. I’ll continue to monitor Foundation announcements, audit reports, and minutes from core developer meetings rather than speculate about a mainnet date.

TON Strategy Swings to a Loss in Q3, Posting a Net Loss of $23.975 Million

The third-quarter 10-Q filing submitted on November 13 by U.S.-listed TON Strategy Company (Nasdaq ticker: TONX) has put the treasury company, whose core business is holding Gram, back in the market spotlight. The filing shows a net loss of $23.975 million in the third quarter, compared with net income of $84.319 million in the same period last year, marking a swing from profit to loss.
Let’s start with the key facts. As of September 30, the company held Gram (formerly Toncoin, renamed following a community governance vote on June 8 this year) with a carrying value of $348.45 million, of which about 233 million tokens were staked. At the operating level, the company reported operating profit of $3.977 million for the quarter, received 9.431 million GRAM in staking rewards, and recognized $13.065 million in staking revenue. For the first three quarters, rewards totaled 21.044 million tokens, corresponding to revenue of $31.086 million. What really pushed the financial statements into the red was net other expenses of $27.224 million, mainly due to changes in the fair value of digital assets. The company’s cumulative net loss for the first three quarters was $38.255 million.
The breakdown shows a company that is profitable at the operating level but losing ground on investments. Staking continues to generate income, but under fair-value accounting, digital asset price fluctuations flow directly through the income statement. In the quarter, the negative fair-value movement far exceeded staking revenue, resulting in a net loss. As long as the portfolio composition remains unchanged, the company’s financial results will remain closely tied to the price of a single asset—an accounting feature that treasury companies cannot easily avoid.
The impact on the crypto market can be viewed across three dimensions. First, transparency: as a U.S.-listed issuer, the company discloses its holdings and staking details every quarter, providing the market with a public window into institutional-level GRAM holdings. Second, token supply: about 233 million GRAM are locked in staking, objectively reducing near-term selling pressure, though potential supply following unstaking is also worth monitoring. Third, valuation: treasury companies are typically valued at a premium or discount to net asset value. Sustained losses may increase discount pressure, in turn affecting future financing and share issuance capacity.
In our editorial assessment, facts must be distinguished from speculation. Confirmed facts include: the main cause of the loss was fair-value changes rather than deteriorating operations; cash and cash equivalents at period-end were $25.302 million, down from $39.493 million at the end of last year; shareholders’ equity was $372.55 million, with 55.427 million shares outstanding; and staking was conducted through BitGo Trust and Blockchain.com (Cayman), entirely via a single nominated validator pool, with no commingling with other clients’ assets. The speculative points are that if the GRAM price stabilizes and rebounds, fair-value changes could turn positive, with the same mechanism also providing upside to reported results; and, given the current cash burn trend, the company may need to consider options for replenishing liquidity in the future. For single-asset treasury companies like this one, the key areas to watch are holdings, staking revenue, and cash reserves—not a single quarter’s profit or loss.

content:
TON Strategy三季度由盈转亏 净亏2397.5万美元

美国上市公司TON Strategy Company（纳斯达克代码TONX）11月13日提交的三季度10-Q文件，把这家以持有Gram为核心的财库型公司重新拉回市场视野。文件显示，公司第三季度净亏损2,397.5万美元，而去年同期为净利润8,431.9万美元，业绩由盈转亏。
先摆核心事实。截至9月30日，公司持有Gram（原Toncoin，今年6月8日经社区治理投票更名）账面价值3.4845亿美元，其中约2.33亿枚处于质押状态。运营层面，当季营业利润为397.7万美元，质押奖励943.1万枚GRAM，确认质押收入1,306.5万美元；前三季度累计奖励2,104.4万枚，对应收入3,108.6万美元。真正把报表拖入亏损的，是2,722.4万美元的其他费用净额，主要来自数字资产公允价值变动。前三季度公司累计净亏损3,825.5万美元。
逻辑拆解来看，这是一份营业层面盈利、投资层面失分的报表。质押生息仍在产生收入，但在公允价值会计下，数字资产价格波动会直接穿透利润表：当季公允价值负向变动远超质押收入，净亏损随之出现。只要持仓结构不变，公司报表就将与单一资产价格深度绑定，这是财库型公司难以回避的会计特征。
对加密市场的影响路径可分三层观察。其一，透明度：作为美股发行人，公司每季度披露持仓与质押细节，为市场提供了观察机构级GRAM持仓的公开窗口。其二，筹码结构：约2.33亿枚GRAM处于质押锁仓，客观上减少短期流通抛压，但解除质押后的潜在供给同样值得跟踪。其三，估值逻辑：财库型公司通常围绕净资产溢价或折价定价，持续亏损会加大折价压力，进而牵动后续融资与增发空间。
编辑判断需要区分事实与推测。可确认的事实包括：亏损主因是公允价值变动而非经营恶化；期末现金及等价物2,530.2万美元，低于去年底的3,949.3万美元；股东权益3.7255亿美元，流通股5,542.7万股；质押通过BitGo Trust与Blockchain.com（开曼）两家机构完成，全部经由单提名验证者池，不与其他客户资产混同。推测部分在于：若GRAM价格企稳回升，公允价值变动存在转正可能，报表弹性同样来自这一机制；按当前现金消耗趋势，公司后续或需考虑补充流动性的选项。对这类单一资产财库公司，观察重点应放在持仓规模、质押收入与现金储备三条主线上，而非单季盈亏本身。

title: Стейкинг Ethereum достиг рекордных 36,5% предложения, несмотря на снижение цены ETH
subTitle:
Главное по теме:#ETH🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥 
Рекордный стейкинг ETH сокращает ликвидное предложение, создавая потенциал для роста при возврате спроса.
Очередь в 2,42 млн ETH при нулевом выходе отражает долгосрочную уверенность, а не спекуляцию.
Слабость ETH и BTC ниже $70 000 — риск, но стейкинг сигналит о структурном дефиците.#BTC走势分析 
Объем эфира (ETH), заблокированного в стейкинге, обновил исторический максимум. По данным Token Terminal, показатель вырос до 36,3–36,5% от совокупного предложения. Предыдущий рекорд в 32,4% был зафиксирован в июне 2026 года, то есть за пять месяцев доля стейкинга увеличилась почти на четыре процентных пункта — и это происходило на падающем рынке.#ETH #ETFvsBTC 
Стейкинг важен не только как источник доходности: валидаторы блокируют ETH для подтверждения транзакций и защиты сети с механизмом proof-of-stake. Чем больше монет отправлено в стейкинг, тем дороже становится потенциальная атака на Ethereum и тем меньше эфира остается в свободном обращении.
Сейчас ETH торгуется вблизи отметки $1 900–2 000, потеряв около 18% за последний месяц. Давление на котировки оказывают снижение биткоина ниже $70 000 и отток средств из спотовых биржевых фондов на эфир. Тем не менее фундаментальная картина сети выглядит иначе: держатели продолжают выводить монеты из ликвидного обращения.
Очередь на вход в стейкинг составляет примерно 2,42 млн ETH, расчетное время ожидания — около 42 дней. Очередь на выход при этом равна нулю. Это означает, что в стейкинг стремится значительно больше участников, чем из него. Для сравнения, в сентябре 2025 года очередь на выход достигала пика около 2,67 млн ETH, но к январю 2026 года почти полностью исчезла.
В сети сейчас насчитывается около 897 000 активных валидаторов, а годовая доходность стейкинга составляет примерно 2,6%. Рост во многом обеспечивают институциональные игроки: казначейская компания BitMine наращивает позиции, а появление стейкинга в спотовых ETH-ETF открыло традиционным инвесторам доступ к доходности. Аналитики XWIN Research Japan, пишущие для CryptoQuant, отмечают, что уровень стейкинга Ethereum продолжал расти даже во время резких коррекций 2022 и 2023 годов.
Расхождение между слабой ценой и рекордным стейкингом создает неоднозначную картину. С одной стороны, на спотовом рынке сохраняется давление продаж, в том числе со стороны институционалов. С другой — сокращение ликвидного предложения ETH может усилить восходящий импульс, если рыночный спрос вернется.#ETFvsBTC $ETH

Solana’s selection is unlikely to have much impact on overall crypto sentiment in the short term, but over the long term, it signals that other chains are challenging Bitcoin’s position.
- Medium term: The industry landscape may be changing. Bitcoin remains a safe-haven asset, but high-performance chains like Solana are starting to compete for business. For now, this looks more like the market digesting pressure. Bitcoin falling below $65,000 isn’t a major collapse, but a correction. translatedData.content:
$ETH  What the hell was that move. I was supposed to be done for the day!

A little after 7 p.m., I opened my phone and noticed the funds in my contract account slowly dwindling. My heart sank—and then I saw I still had an open order. It suddenly hit me: after trading in the afternoon, I’d forgotten to cancel a pending order.

The candlesticks were already pushing up, so I rushed to set a stop-loss. My fingers were still too slow, and it got stopped out in 7 minutes: short from 1825, closed at 1840.6, -163.37. Just like that, I’d handed back most of what I’d made during the day.

Normally, I might have let my emotions take over. But this time I didn’t chase the price or place a revenge trade. I just waited for a pullback, then a rebound. The pullback was brutal, though, and the rebound took forever. I waited until 17:20 before getting long at 1825.41, then held all the way to 1827.09: 90 ETH, held for 1 hour and 59 minutes, +151.74. That more or less filled the hole.

The final tally: -163.37 + 151.74 = -11.63. After a whole afternoon and evening of trading, I was down just over eleven bucks net. Not exactly a win, but at least I didn’t let one forgotten order turn into a liquidation.

A couple of lessons from reviewing the trade—just the clumsy observations of a little retail trader, still being tested:

First, placing a limit order isn’t the end of the job; canceling orders is part of trading too. An order you forget to cancel is a handle you leave for the market to grab—it doesn’t care whether you remember it, just waits for you to look away.

Second, after getting stopped out, your first thought shouldn’t be “win it back,” but “don’t let it get worse.” I managed to fill the hole this time not because I got the direction of that long trade right, but because I didn’t chase the price in an emotional state or turn -163 into -500. You can get the direction wrong, but you can’t lose your rhythm. I wrote that in my last post, and today I paid tuition once again to hammer it home.

Position sizing is still my usual: a tiny fraction, ant-sized. 100x is just the leverage number; what really controls risk is the position size relative to your capital. A high multiplier doesn’t necessarily mean high risk—a high ratio does.

(100x is extremely risky. This is just a personal account of what I’m doing, not investment advice. I hope none of you ever learn the hard way by forgetting to cancel an order.)

Have you ever been burned by a “limit order you forgot to cancel”? Raise a hand in the comments and let me know I’m not alone.

$ETH 神它喵的操作。今天本来已经收工了的！

19 点多打开手机，瞄到合约账户资金怎么在一点点变少，心里咯噔一下——再一看，居然还有单。才想起来下午操作完，有张挂单忘了撤。

当时 K 线已经往上顶了，我赶紧设止损，手速还是慢了一步，7 分钟被打损：1825 进的空、1840.6 出来，-163.37。这一下，等于把白天忙活的大半又还了回去。

换平时我可能就上头了。但这次没追高、没报复性开单，就等回调、等反抽。结果这货回调太狠、反抽太墨迹，磨到 17:20 才在 1825.41 接到多，一路拿到 1827.09，90 ETH、历时 1 小时 59 分，+151.74，把窟窿基本填平。

算总账：-163.37 + 151.74 = -11.63。折腾一下午加一晚上，净亏十一块多。谈不上赢，但也没让一张忘撤的单子，演变成爆仓。

复盘两句，都是小韭菜的笨体会，还在验证：

第一，挂单不是设完就完事，撤单也是操作的一部分。 忘撤的单子，就是留给市场的把柄——它不问你记不记得，只等你不注意。

第二，被打损之后，第一反应不该是"打回来"，而是"别扩大"。 我这次能填平窟窿，靠的不是那笔多单方向对，而是没在情绪里追高、没把 -163 变成 -500。方向可以错，节奏不能乱，这句我上一篇刚写过，今天算是又交了一次学费把它焊牢。

仓位还是老规矩：蚂蚁仓级别的小比例，100x 只是杠杆数字，真正管住风险的是仓位占本金的比例——倍数高不等于危险，比例高才是。

（100x 高危，本文仅个人进行时记录，非投资建议。忘撤单这种事，希望你们一个都别学。）

title: BTC Breaks Below $64,000 Amid $2B+ Liquidations: Key Drivers & What to Watch
subTitle:
Crypto markets remained under heavy pressure on November 15: $BTC briefly dipped below $63,000 before slipping back under $64,000 as of 07:42 UTC, $ETH broke below $1,800 (trading near $1,798), and $BNB fell under $590 yesterday.

According to CoinGlass data, 24-hour crypto futures liquidations hit $2.058 billion as cascading long liquidations accelerated after key support levels gave way. Four core factors are driving this pullback:

1. Tightening Macro Rate Expectations
October US CPI rose 0.4% month-over-month, coming in hotter than expected and fueling fears of a 50 bps Fed rate hike in December. The US Dollar Index (DXY) pushed above 103 (a new high since April 2025) while 10-year Treasury yields climbed past 5.1%. Combined with Middle East geopolitical tensions, global risk assets are seeing broad de-risking.

2. Consecutive Spot ETF Outflows
US spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded seven consecutive sessions of net outflows totaling roughly $1.91 billion, signaling softer near-term institutional demand. Still, not every desk is stepping back—on-chain data shows Morgan Stanley's spot Bitcoin ETF (MSBT) added around 735 BTC (~$52.87 million) during this week's dip.

3. Shrinking Stablecoin Liquidity
Glassnode data shows total stablecoin supply contracted by $17 billion over the past 30 days, marking the steepest monthly drop since 2022. Capital rotating back into fiat leaves less on-chain dry powder to absorb sudden selloffs.

4. Index Rebalancing Overhang
MSCI's planned removal of Strategy and Metaplanet from its indexes on November 30 brings an estimated ~$1.59 billion in passive outflow expectations, keeping bulls cautious heading into month-end.

📌 Key Signals to Watch Next
Volatility typically spikes during leverage flush-outs and tightening liquidity. Traders are closely watching:
• Whether leveraged liquidations are nearing exhaustion and open interest/funding rates reset to healthier levels.
• When US spot BTC and ETH ETF flows flip back to net inflows.
• Institutional absorption around the late-November MSCI rebalancing window.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Matters More Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own performance. They’ve got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your rationale), what went right or wrong (in terms of execution),
and what you’ll do differently next time (specific actions). Stick with it for a month, and you’ll be shocked to discover: your losses
Your trading log has lots of the same mistakes repeating—for example, always reversing direction right after a stop-loss,
or never letting winning trades run.

Market conditions change, but your behavioral patterns won’t change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher; your trade history is your report card. Don’t just look at your account balance—go through your trading records.

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | Five Rules I Keep Beside My Screen—Sharing Them Just as They Are Today
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, you can forget every lesson, so I wrote these down and stuck them where I can see them:

1. Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t, don’t enter.
2. Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
3. Don’t add to a losing position. Never average down.
4. After three losing trades in a row, stop for the day. Just watch—don’t trade.
5. Withdraw some of your profits. The money you take out is real; what you leave behind is peace of mind.

Just five rules, and not one of them is about how to read the market. Because the reason people lose big
is never that they read the market wrong—it’s that their execution broke down. Let’s keep each other accountable.

“Non-fungible”—what exactly does that term mean?
Here’s how I understand it: an NFT records which address owns that token number. It doesn’t automatically mean you own the copyright to the image; the scope of your rights depends on the license provided by the project.
Many NFTs only record the token number and a link to metadata on the blockchain. The artwork file is usually stored on IPFS or on the project’s server.
My habit now: before buying an NFT, I check the collection’s contract address. There are plenty of collections with the same name, so don’t just go by the image and name.
Minting and trading NFTs on Ethereum requires $ETH  to pay for gas.

Institutional ETH staking hinges on redemption flexibility｜ETHB quarterly report discloses 76.4% staked｜Re-enter above 1,830

My view is that institutional products expanding the ways to hold ETH is a positive development, but I would not take a “high staking ratio” as direct evidence of new buying for now. The issuer filed the iShares Staked Ethereum Trust ETF’s Q3 report with the U.S. SEC, disclosing that as of September 30, 337,045 ETH—76.4% of its holdings—was being staked through third parties. The same figure can also be verified in the quarterly report on the issuer’s website. This is a quarter-end balance, not new purchases on November 15, and it does not mean that all U.S. spot ETH funds stake at this ratio. The report also lists quarterly staking income of about $3.067 million, but yield cannot be simply equated with fund shares, price fluctuations, fees, and redemptions.

The key point for me is the liquidity structure. Staking can generate on-chain returns for holders, but it also means fund managers must account for redemption demand, exit queues, and unstaked buffers. If the market sees concentrated redemptions, a fund may first use its unstaked portion; if that buffer is insufficient, the time needed to unstake could affect execution arrangements. The ratio disclosed in the quarterly report can help assess the product’s risk design, but it does not prove that redemption pressure exists today, nor should staked ETH be treated as permanently locked up. The discussion on Square is focused on the rebound and PPI right now. An independent assessment of ETH should focus on whether fund flows and product structure can support the price, rather than borrowing the BTC narrative to conclude that ETH must rise.

Market performance so far has been mixed: as I write, ETH/USDT on Binance is around $1,827.69, still down about 4.35% over the rolling 24 hours, with a range of $1,711.08 to $1,912.68. The price has rebounded from its low but has yet to recover the top of the range; I would not attribute this rebound to a quarterly report disclosing data from the end of September. $1,830 is the immediate confirmation level, $1,910–$1,913 is the supply zone near the 24-hour high, and around $1,710 is the risk line at this swing low. If the price moves above $1,830 but quickly falls back below it, that would indicate insufficient buying momentum; if $1,710 gives way again, the short-term bullish view is invalidated.

If I were trading this myself: I would not chase the rally now, and would only consider a spot long, using no more than 1.2% of my account’s net asset value. The entry conditions are for ETH to close above $1,830 for two consecutive one-hour candles, then hold $1,830 on a retest, while also watching for no significant deterioration in ETH fund net flows on the next U.S. trading day. There are no new daily U.S. fund creation and redemption data over the weekend, so I can’t pretend this has already been confirmed. If triggered, I would first target $1,880 and cut the position by half there; if the price then holds above that level on strong volume, I would look to $1,910–$1,913 and scale out of the remainder in stages. I would place the initial stop below $1,785. If, after entry, two consecutive one-hour candles close back below $1,830, I would reduce the position first; below $1,785, I would close it all. If the conditions are not met, I would stay out and wait. If fund redemptions accelerate, liquidity for staking exits tightens, or $1,710 breaks, the plan is invalidated; I would not use high leverage to try to recover losses.

#ETH
The above is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
ETH机构质押要看赎回弹性｜ETHB季报披露76.4%已质押｜1830上方再参与

我的态度是认可机构产品拓宽ETH持有方式，但暂不把“质押比例高”直接理解成新买盘。iShares Staked Ethereum Trust ETF的三季报由发行方提交至美国SEC，披露截至9月30日持有的ETH中有337045枚、占头寸76.4%，通过第三方参与质押；发行方官网所载同一份季报也能核对这个数字。这是季度末存量，不是11月15日新增购买，更不代表所有美国现货ETH基金都按这个比例质押。报告还列出季度质押收入约306.7万美元，但收益与基金份额、币价波动、费用和赎回之间不能简单画等号。

我看这条信息的重点是流动性结构。质押可给持有者带来链上收益，却会让基金管理人同时考虑赎回需求、退出队列和未质押缓冲。若市场出现集中赎回，基金可能先动用未质押部分；若缓冲不足，解质押所需时间会影响执行安排。季报披露的比例可以帮助判断产品风险设计，但不能据此断言今天存在赎回压力，也不能把质押中的ETH算成永久锁仓。广场眼下热议反弹和PPI，ETH的独立判断应落在资金流与产品结构能否配合价格，而不是借用BTC话题得出ETH必涨。

已发生的市场表现偏混合：截至写稿，币安ETH/USDT约1827.69美元，滚动24小时仍跌约4.35%，区间1711.08至1912.68美元。价格从低点反弹，尚未收复区间上沿；我不会把这段反弹归因于一份披露9月末数据的季报。1830美元是眼前的确认位，1910至1913美元是24小时高点附近的供应区，1710美元附近则是本轮低位风险线。若价格越过1830却很快跌回，说明买盘持续性不足；若1710再失守，短线偏多判断被推翻。

如果是我自己交易：现在不参与追涨，方向只考虑现货做多，最多使用账户净值的1.2%。入场条件是ETH连续两根一小时K线收在1830美元上方，回踩1830守住，并观察下一个美股交易日ETH基金净流量没有明显恶化；周末没有新的美股日度申赎数据，不能假装已经确认。触发后先看1880美元，触及减半；若放量站稳再看1910至1913美元，剩余分批减。初始止损放在1785美元下方；若入场后连续两根一小时K线收回1830下方，先减仓，跌破1785全部平仓。若条件不满足就空仓等待。若基金赎回扩张、质押退出流动性吃紧或1710失守，计划失效，不开高杠杆补亏。

#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Getting Rich Slowly: What Compounding Really Looks Like in Crypto
translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who really hold on to their gains in this market are the ones who “get rich slowly.”
Let's do the math: earning just 1% a day over 250 trading days a year gives you 12 times your money; consistently earning 10% a month,
gets you 30 times your money in three years. It may not sound thrilling, but it has one remarkable advantage—it doesn't depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market opportunities have to be waited for, but discipline is up to you. Don't make your goal
“doubling your money this week.” Make it “no major mistakes this week.” The money from the former is given to you by the market,
while the ability behind the latter is yours. The market opens every day, but only those who preserve their capital get to keep playing.

Eloise Cobell grew up on the Blackfeet Reservation. She studied accounting, became the tribe’s treasurer, and noticed that the numbers didn’t add up. One landowner showed her a statement: an oil company had received $6,000 from his land, but he had been paid $89. She was told that she “didn’t know how to read financial statements.” But Cobell had a business education and had founded the first bank on the reservation.

The problem was systemic: for more than a century, the U.S. government had collected royalties from oil, gas, timber, and grazing on Native American lands, but couldn’t properly account for the money. In 1996, she filed a class-action lawsuit. The case was settled in 2009–2011 for $3.4 billion: $1.4 billion in direct payments, $1.9 billion to buy back fractionated land and return it to tribes, and $60 million for a scholarship fund named in her honor. Cobell died in 2011, four months before the first payments were made; in 2016, she was posthumously awarded the Presidential Medal of Freedom. Her weapons were accounting ledgers, patience, and one question: “Where’s the money?” And even the most powerful nation had to answer.

Елуїз Кобелл виросла в резервації Блекфіт. Вивчала бухгалтерію, стала казначеєм племені й помітила: цифри не сходяться. Один власник землі показав звіт: нафтова компанія отримала $6 000 з його ділянки, а йому прийшло $89. Їй відповіли, що вона «не вміє читати фінансові звіти». Але Кобелл мала бізнес-освіту й заснувала перший банк у резервації.

Проблема була в системі: понад століття уряд США збирав роялті за нафту, газ, деревину й випас на землях корінних американців, але не міг належно облікувати кошти. У 1996 році вона подала колективний позов. У 2009–2011 роках справу врегулювали на $3,4 млрд: $1,4 млрд — прямі виплати, $1,9 млрд — викуп роздроблених земель і повернення племенам, $60 млн — стипендійний фонд її імені. Кобелл померла у 2011-му за чотири місяці до перших виплат; у 2016-му її посмертно нагородили Президентською медаллю Свободи. Її зброєю були бухгалтерські книги, терпіння і запитання: «Де гроші?» І навіть наймогутнішій державі довелося відповісти.

title: Достатньо бухгалтерської освіти, документів, наполегливості та одного запитання: де гроші?
subTitle:
Арифметика справедливості: як одна жінка змусила уряд США відповісти на запитання «Де гроші?»
Історія Елуїз Кобелл — про фінансову несправедливість, державну відповідальність і силу професійних знань
DVA — факти без хайпу
ФАКТ • ПЕРЕВІРКА • ЕКОНОМІКА • ПРАВО • РІШЕННЯ
Іноді для боротьби з могутньою державою не потрібна зброя. Достатньо бухгалтерської освіти, документів, наполегливості та одного запитання: де гроші?
Історія Елуїз Кобелл — це не просто біографія громадської діячки. Це хроніка багаторічної боротьби за майнові права корінних американців, викриття системних проблем державного обліку та спроба відновити довіру до інституцій, які мали захищати чужі активи.
 1. Історичне коріння проблеми: земля, власність і державне управління
У 1887 році в США ухвалили Закон Дауеса (General Allotment Act). Він передбачав поділ частини общинних земель корінних народів на індивідуальні наділи. Значні площі земель, які залишалися після розподілу, могли передаватися іншим власникам.
Ця політика змінила земельні відносини корінних народів і створила передумови для формування системи індивідуальних трастових рахунків.
Федеральний уряд США взяв на себе обов'язок управляти певними земельними активами та доходами від їх використання. Йшлося про платежі за видобуток нафти й газу, оренду землі, заготівлю деревини, випас худоби та іншу господарську діяльність.
Держава мала збирати кошти, вести облік і розподіляти належні виплати власникам.
Однак протягом десятиліть система накопичувала серйозні проблеми: неповні фінансові записи, помилки в розрахунках, відсутні документи та неналежне управління рахунками.
Виникла принципова суперечність: уряд управляв чужими активами, але не міг належним чином підтвердити повну історію фінансових операцій.
У матеріалах судового процесу фігурували оцінки потенційних сум претензій, які сягали приблизно $177 млрд залежно від методики розрахунку. Але цю цифру не можна трактувати як доведену суму викрадених або зниклих коштів. Це була оцінка можливих зобов'язань за однією з методик позивачів.
Саме тут починається історія Елуїз Кобелл.
 2. Елуїз Кобелл: компетентність проти системи
Кобелл народилася 1945 року в резервації Блэкфіт у штаті Монтана. Вона виросла в складних побутових умовах, здобула освіту в галузі бухгалтерського обліку та бізнесу, а згодом повернулася до своєї громади.
Працюючи казначеєм нації Блэкфіт, вона почала звертати увагу на невідповідності між доходами від використання земель і виплатами їхнім власникам.
Один із показових прикладів, який наводиться в матеріалах про її діяльність: за звітом, компанія отримала $6000 від використання земельної ділянки, тоді як власник отримав лише $89.
Це викликало закономірне запитання: як саме розраховуються виплати та куди спрямовується решта коштів?
Коли Кобелл вимагала пояснень, їй заперечували, посилаючись на нібито недостатнє розуміння фінансових документів.
Однак вона мала відповідну освіту та практичний досвід.
У 1987 році Кобелл допомогла заснувати Blackfeet National Bank — перший банк, що належав індіанському племені. Його створення мало забезпечити фінансові послуги громаді, яка не мала належного банківського обслуговування.
У 1997 році Фонд Макартура присудив їй престижну стипендію, відому як «грант геніїв».
Її професійна діяльність ґрунтувалася на простому принципі: фінансова звітність повинна підтверджуватися документами, а не авторитетом установи, яка її складає.
 3. Судовий процес: коли запитань стало недостатньо
Упродовж 1980-х і 1990-х років Кобелл домагалася реформування системи управління трастовими коштами.
Коли адміністративні звернення не дали бажаного результату, 10 червня 1996 року вона стала однією з позивачок у колективному процесі Cobell v. Salazar проти федерального уряду США.
Позов стосувався управління індивідуальними трастовими рахунками корінних американців та виконання державою своїх обов'язків щодо обліку й розподілу доходів.
Судовий процес тривав роками. Уряд захищався, посилаючись на складність відновлення історичних записів, обсяг документів та обмеженість можливостей провести повний облік.
Справа супроводжувалася судовими рішеннями, апеляціями та тривалими юридичними суперечками.
Для Кобелл це означало багаторічну боротьбу, поїздки між Монтаною та Вашингтоном, відрив від родини й громади.
Її вимога залишалася незмінною: якщо держава управляє чужими коштами, вона повинна документально підтвердити, що відбувалося з цими коштами.
Це вже було не лише питання бухгалтерії. Це стало питанням відповідальності держави перед власниками майна.
 4. $3,4 млрд: історичне врегулювання з юридичними обмеженнями
У грудні 2009 року адміністрація Барака Обами досягла домовленості про врегулювання спору на загальну суму $3,4 млрд.
У 2010 році Конгрес США затвердив необхідне законодавство, а 8 грудня президент Обама підписав Claims Resolution Act of 2010.
20 червня 2011 року федеральний суд схвалив угоду. Після подальших апеляцій і завершення юридичних процедур вона набула остаточної сили 24 листопада 2012 року.
Структура врегулювання передбачала:
- $1,5 млрд — фонд для виплат учасникам колективного позову у зв'язку з претензіями щодо історичного обліку та управління трастовими активами. Приблизно $1,4 млрд призначалися безпосередньо для розподілу між учасниками з урахуванням умов угоди.
- $1,9 млрд — фонд добровільного викупу роздроблених земельних часток із метою консолідації земель та їх повернення під управління племен.
- До $60 млн — на освітні стипендії для представників корінних народів США та Аляски. Ці кошти передбачалися в межах земельного фонду, а не як додаткова сума понад $3,4 млрд.
Важливо розуміти: врегулювання не означало, що вдалося відновити кожну фінансову операцію за попередні десятиліття або повернути всі потенційно втрачені доходи.
Це було масштабне юридичне врегулювання претензій, яке дозволило здійснити виплати та започаткувати програму консолідації земель.
Навіть сама Кобелл визнавала, що отриманий результат не міг повністю компенсувати історичні втрати.
 5. Чому ця історія важлива для сучасної економіки?
Справа Кобелл демонструє три фундаментальні принципи, актуальні далеко за межами американської судової системи.
Перший — власність без прозорого обліку залишається вразливою.
Юридичне право на актив саме по собі не гарантує контролю над доходами від нього. Потрібні документи, зрозуміла звітність і можливість незалежної перевірки.
Другий — управління чужими активами передбачає відповідальність.
Держава, банк, компанія або фінансовий посередник, які управляють чужими коштами, повинні пояснювати свої операції. Довіра не може замінювати контроль.
Третій — фінансова грамотність є інструментом захисту майнових прав.
Кобелл використала знання бухгалтерського обліку не просто для роботи з цифрами. Вона перетворила ці знання на інструмент суспільного контролю та юридичного захисту.
 6. Від бухгалтерської книги до цифрових фінансів
Історія Кобелл має особливе значення в епоху цифрових активів, блокчейну та токенізованої власності.
Сучасні технології дозволяють фіксувати транзакції, перевіряти рух активів і створювати прозоріші механізми обліку.
Але тут є важлива відмінність: наявність запису в блокчейні ще не доводить законність походження коштів, справедливість розподілу чи виконання зобов'язань перед власником.
Технологія може зробити операції доступнішими для перевірки, але не замінює правового захисту, незалежного аудиту та відповідальності тих, хто управляє активами.
Тому майбутнє фінансової системи залежить не лише від технологій, а й від якості правил, за якими вони працюють.
 7. Спадщина Елуїз Кобелл
16 жовтня 2011 року Елуїз Кобелл померла від раку у віці 65 років. Вона не дожила до остаточного завершення всіх процедур реалізації врегулювання.
У 2016 році президент Барак Обама посмертно нагородив її Президентською медаллю Свободи.
У 2023 році її ім'я внесли до Національної зали слави жінок.
Однак головна спадщина Кобелл — не нагороди й не сама сума судового врегулювання.
Вона показала, що навіть найпотужніша інституція повинна відповідати за управління чужою власністю. І що професійні знання, наполегливість та юридичні механізми можуть перетворити суспільну проблему на предмет конкретної відповідальності.
 Висновок DVA: три складові фінансової справедливості
Історію Елуїз Кобелл можна звести до трьох понять:
ВЛАСНІСТЬ — кому належать гроші та активи?
ОБЛІК — що відбувається з ними та чи можна перевірити кожну операцію?
ПІДЗВІТНІСТЬ — хто несе відповідальність за управління та результат?
Якщо хоча б одна складова відсутня, виникає ризик зловживань, втрати довіри та порушення майнових прав.
Елуїз Кобелл не боролася зброєю. Її інструментами були знання, документи, бухгалтерські розрахунки й суд.
Вона нагадала світу важливу істину: гроші, якими управляють від імені власника, не перестають бути його власністю.
А довіра до фінансової системи починається не з обіцянок, а з можливості перевірити цифри.
Бо фінансова справедливість починається з простого запитання: кому належать гроші, хто ними управляє і де документальне підтвердження кожної операції?
DVA — факти без хайпу.
ФАКТ • ПЕРЕВІРКА • РІШЕННЯ
Збереження цінностей та часу.
Не фінансова порада.
 Джерела для фактологічної перевірки
* [MacArthur Foundation — Elouise Cobell](https://www.macfound.org/fellows/class-of-1997/elouise-c-cobell?utm_source=chatgpt.com) — професійна діяльність і нагорода 1997 року.
* [National Women's History Museum — біографія Елуїз Кобелл](https://www.womenshistory.org/education-resources/biographies/elouise-cobell-yellow-bird-woman?utm_source=chatgpt.com) — освіта, заснування банку та громадська діяльність.
* [U.S. Department of the Interior — Cobell Settlement](https://www.doi.gov/cobell?utm_source=chatgpt.com) — юридична структура врегулювання.
* [Congressional Research Service — The Indian Trust Fund Litigation](https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/RL34628.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com) — історія судового процесу та фінансові претензії.
* [U.S. Department of the Interior — Land Buy-Back Program](https://www.doi.gov/node/1354?utm_source=chatgpt.com) — результати програми консолідації земель.
Редакторська оцінка: тепер матеріал чітко розділяє історичні факти, судові претензії та результати врегулювання. Найважливіше — він не ототожнює $177 млрд потенційних претензій із доведеними втратами та правильно пояснює структуру $3,4 млрд. Це відповідає аналітичному підходу DVA.
Не фінансова порада.

2026年11月15日，以太坊市场同样经历了剧烈震荡。ETH最低下探至1773美元，随后在鲸鱼资金大举入场的推动下强势反弹至1845美元，当前价格报1797美元，24小时跌幅5.28%。市场呈现出明显的多空博弈格局，机构资金持续撤离与聪明钱积极抄底形成鲜明对比。

二、价格走势分析

从小时K线来看，ETH在早盘延续弱势，从1813美元逐步下滑至1782美元，随后在1773美元获得支撑并展开反弹。最新两根K线显示，价格从1782美元快速拉升至1811美元，接着进一步冲高至1845美元，最终收于1824美元，形成了连续两根实体较长的阳线。

均线系统方面，ETH当前价格1797美元运行在7日均线1806美元下方，同时远低于25日均线1822美元和99日均线1953美元。三条均线呈明显的空头排列，中期下行趋势未改。但7日均线已开始走平，短期有企稳迹象。

布林带方面，价格从下轨1724美元附近反弹至中轨1801美元上方，上轨压力位在1871美元。KDJ指标中K线74、D线65、J线91，三线向上发散，短期多头占据优势。威廉指标WR回升至负15，进入强势区域。

以太坊市场当前面临的最大压力来自机构资金的持续撤离。美国现货以太坊ETF连续录得净流出，单日净流出达到1.448亿美元，两周累计流出接近4亿美元。这种机构级别的持续减仓对价格形成了沉重的压制。

The minutes show that at the September 15–16 meeting, all 19 officials supported raising the federal funds target range by 25 basis points, to between 3.75% and 4%. This was the Fed’s first rate hike since July 2023. Most participants judged that another rate increase before year-end could be appropriate; a few even expected action at both the October and December meetings. The reasons for supporting a hike were not entirely the same: many officials were concerned that inflationary pressures could intensify further, while others viewed tightening as necessary based on their assessment of the economic outlook. The minutes also show that some officials considered the policy rate before the September hike to be non-restrictive, or only mildly restrictive. But the minutes did not present an October hike as a firm plan. Officials stressed that they would remain open-minded at every meeting, with future decisions dependent on incoming information. Market pricing also reversed rapidly: after the September hike, federal funds futures briefly indicated about a 70% chance of another hike in October. After Vice Chair Jefferson and New York Fed President Williams said in turn that there was time to observe economic developments, that probability fell to about 20%. The two-year Treasury yield, which is particularly sensitive to policy expectations, fell by more than 10 basis points over the past week, to near 4.8%. The September jobs report released last week also did not change the market’s view. Average hourly earnings rose 3% year over year, the slowest pace in more than five years, pointing to a stable but not overheated labor market. Looking at the logic, the minutes’ hawkish tone lies in the consensus and the rate path, not in the precise timing. The inflation backdrop helps explain why the consensus remains strong: geopolitical conflicts have driven up fuel costs, while the AI investment boom and tariffs are also seen as adding to broader inflationary pressures. Chair Warsh said that this summer’s inflation data had not shown a clear improvement in underlying trends, and that the latest hike was intended to remove a dose of accommodation. Some of the confidence behind not rushing in October comes from rising longer-term Treasury yields, which are already constraining the real economy through borrowing costs such as mortgage rates. Former Philadelphia Fed President Harker put it bluntly: the Fed is not really in a hurry right now. The minutes also discussed stress in the Treasury market, an unusual topic: a few participants advocated strengthening tools and communications in advance to address market dysfunction, while Minneapolis Fed President Kashkari said the Treasury market was functioning well and saw no reason to intervene. The potential impact on crypto markets is a matter of logical inference, not established fact: expectations for short-term interest rates directly affect dollar liquidity and risk appetite, while crypto assets have historically been highly sensitive to marginal changes in liquidity. If the CPI report due October 14 raises the probability of a rate hike, risk assets could come under temporary pressure; if the data are moderate, the case for pausing rate hikes could improve liquidity expectations. It is important to stress that the minutes do not directly address crypto markets; the transmission described above is only an analytical framework. Editor’s view: The minutes’ signal can be summed up as steady but hawkish, with the real uncertainty left to the data. Looking ahead, three points are worth tracking: the October 14 CPI report, the October 27–28 policy meeting, and whether the three officials who voted against holding rates steady in July will again argue for a rate hike. Rather than betting on the outcome of a single meeting, it is better to watch for changes in the direction of the rate path and liquidity conditions.

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场情绪正在经历从极度悲观到谨慎乐观的转变。最引人注目的是鲸鱼资金的大举入场。据报道，与知名加密投资人Erik Voorhees关联的钱包在低位买入了六万三千五百四十枚ETH，价值约一点二五亿美元。其他鲸鱼地址累计增持了九万五千零二十四枚ETH。这种大规模的抄底行为传递出强烈的信心信号。

供应面的数据更加令人振奋。币安交易所的ETH储备降至约二百九十万枚，创下二零二一年以来的最低水平。过去三十天持续出现净流出，表明大量ETH正从交易所转向自托管钱包。结合质押供应比例已升至约百分之三十六，且有九十万枚ETH在排队等待入场，流通中的可售ETH数量正在急剧减少。供应紧缩与需求增加的双重作用，为价格上行提供了坚实基础。

然而，风险因素不容忽视。以太坊基金会和早期投资者的分配抛售预期仍在压制市场情绪，企业资产负债表上持有的ETH面临约九十七亿美元的未实现亏损，若价格再度走低可能引发被迫减仓。此外，持续的机构ETF赎回和股市逆风也限制了ETH的反弹空间。

短期来看，ETH若能放量突破一千八百四十四美元的布林带上轨，则有望向一千九百美元的心理关口发起冲击。若回调，一千八百零八美元的二十五日均线将是重要支撑。在鲸鱼持续买入和交易所储备创新低的双重利好下，ETH的中期前景值得看好。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Getting Rich Slowly: What Compounding Really Looks Like in Crypto
translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly hold on to their gains in this market are the ones who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day over 250 trading days in a year would multiply your money by 12; consistently earning 10% a month,
would multiply it 30-fold over three years. It doesn’t sound thrilling, but there’s something remarkable about it—it doesn’t rely on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market conditions are something you wait for; discipline is up to you. Don’t set your goal
as “double my money this week.” Set it as “make no major mistakes this week.” The money from the first goal comes from the market,
but the ability behind the second is yours. The market is open every day, but only those who preserve their capital have what it takes to keep playing.

ETH rebounds, but upgrade still awaits audit | Glamsterdam testnet delayed | I’ll wait for $1,850 and the developer meeting before deciding

My stance is cautiously bullish, but I’m not chasing the rally for now. The Ethereum Foundation’s November 6 developer announcement said that testing Glamsterdam revealed that EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 alter some Gas accounting invariants, potentially affecting deployed contracts that rely on those old assumptions. Core developers therefore postponed the Hoodi testnet fork and will reschedule once the issues are clarified. An update on November 9 added that four reports involving deployed contracts had been received. It recommended waiting until the audit results are published and reviewers have had time to assess them before deciding whether to change the specifications or schedule the Hoodi upgrade. The timeline lists the November 16 developer discussion as the next point to watch. These are publicly disclosed development and audit updates; they do not mean Ethereum’s mainnet has malfunctioned, nor do they mean a new upgrade date has been set today.

I’m paying particular attention to how the risks could spread: if assumptions about Gas made by older contracts are invalidated, applications could fail to execute or incur unusual costs after the upgrade. The Foundation and auditors are investigating first and delaying the testnet, which may postpone some upgrade-related narratives in the short term, but also reduces the tail risk to the ecosystem from a rushed activation. ChainSecurity’s technical note and the Foundation’s announcement corroborate each other. Which specific projects may ultimately need modifications remains to be seen pending the public audit and responses from the projects themselves. I won’t turn “could be affected” into “has already been attacked,” or describe a meeting on the calendar as an approved upgrade.

As for the market, ETH/USDT on Binance is trading around $1,827, up about 3.40% over 24 hours, with a range of $1,711 to $1,845. The rebound has already taken place, but the price remains below the intraday high, suggesting the market hasn’t priced in this development news in one direction. First, I’ll watch to see whether the $1,845–$1,850 area holds, then keep an eye on $1,880. On the downside, I’m watching $1,800 and $1,760. translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | When You Hold a Losing Position, Your Brain Is Deceiving You
translatedData.subTitle:
What is someone down 50% looking at? The “all-time high,” thinking to themselves: “If it gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Be warned: this thought is all attachment, no logic. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to supply and demand in the present.

Once you’re stuck holding a losing position, you’ll automatically seek out good news and block out bad news. This is called confirmation bias. You’ll think,
“This time is different.” Those five words have burned more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is actually simple, but hard to put into practice: before opening a position, write down “under what circumstances the logic behind this trade
becomes invalid,” then act when the time comes, regardless of how you feel. Separate your decisions from the act of holding, and you’ll be able to see clearly.

【ETH’s greatest value isn’t speed, but “trusted settlement”】

Think of ETH as the foundation of a city: Layer 2s are like business districts and roads. No matter how fast they run, transactions and assets ultimately still need access to secure settlement. More roads don’t necessarily mean a thriving economy; what’s missing is recurring spending.

MegaETH cut 20% of its staff and pivoted to AI, while DeFi TVL fell from over $245 million to $8.8 million. This shows that a tech narrative doesn’t guarantee commercial traction: if applications don’t migrate and fees don’t materialize, users will vote with their feet.

ETH’s core value isn’t benchmark performance, but providing settlement that’s difficult to replace. In practice, Layer 2 teams, users, and fee-sharing participants are all affected. Only chains that retain real assets and sustained activity can support their valuations. The business question is simple: Who pays, and which layer ultimately receives the money?

The FNG is just 10, ETH is down 18.1% for the week, $1,679 is support, and $1,877 is resistance, with trading volume rising. But cheap doesn’t necessarily mean worth buying; I’m more interested in whether genuine on-chain demand can provide support.

二、以太坊价格走势回顾

北京时间2026年11月15日，以太坊同样经历了大幅回调。ETH从前期高点一路下挫，最深跌至约1710美元附近，创下7月以来的新低。在整体市场恐慌的大背景下，ETH的跌幅一度超过同期BTC的表现。

三、技术指标深度解读

均线系统方面，7周期均线约为1818美元，25周期均线约为1803美元，价格站在短期均线上方，短线偏多。但99周期均线高达1924美元，距离当前价格仍有约5%的空间，中长期空头格局未改。指数移动均线方面，7周期EMA为1819美元，25周期EMA为1821美元，99周期EMA为1910美元，同样呈现典型的空头排列。

MACD指标方面，快线值为负4.68，慢线值为负8.86，柱状图为正值4.18。MACD柱状图连续五个周期保持正值，显示空头动能持续衰减，短期反弹趋势仍在延续。但快慢线均处于零轴下方较深位置，说明中期趋势依然偏弱。

RSI指标方面，6周期RSI为48.4，12周期RSI为48.5，24周期RSI为44.8。此前6周期RSI一度跌至11附近的极端超卖区域，目前回升至中性水平，但尚未进入强势区域。值得注意的是，RSI在从超卖区回升的过程中曾短暂突破60，随后又回落，显示多头力量不够持久。

布林带指标显示，上轨约1841美元，中轨约1815美元，下轨约1790美元。价格目前在中轨上方运行，接近上轨位置，短线面临上轨压力。ATR指标为23美元，较前期有所下降，波动率正在收窄。

KDJ指标中，K值为55.3，D值为57.2，J值为51.6，三线在中性区域运行，K线从上方回落穿越D线，形成短期死叉信号，暗示短线可能面临回调压力。威廉指标WR为负42，从超卖区域回升至中性偏弱区域。

四、市场情绪与资金面分析

以太坊当前面临多重压力。以太坊基金会在过去四天通过CoWSwap出售了7500枚ETH，价值约1452万美元，这一举动在本就脆弱的市场中进一步打击了投资者信心。此外，某大型持有者面临约607万枚ETH约97亿美元的未实现亏损，市场担忧其可能被迫减持。

然而，积极信号同样存在。与 Erik Voorhees 关联的鲸鱼钱包在此期间大举买入63540枚ETH，价值约1.25亿美元，显示部分聪明资金正在逆势吸筹。币安交易所的ETH储备降至约290万枚，为2021年以来的最低水平，表明大量投资者将ETH转入自托管钱包，长期持有意愿增强。网络质押率已达到约36%，进一步锁定了流通供应。

从链上数据来看，超级趋势线指标维持在1758美元，当前价格位于其上方，短期支撑有效。抛物线SAR指标为1794美元，价格在其上方运行。OBV指标为负值且有所恶化，说明资金面整体仍偏弱。StochRSI指标为71.8，从超买区域回落，短线可能需要消化前期涨幅。

综合判断，ETH短期在1790至1860美元区间震荡的概率较大。若能有效突破1860美元，则有望向1920美元发起挑战；若跌破1790美元支撑，则可能重新测试1710美元低点。在基金会持续抛售和ETF资金外流的背景下，投资者需保持警惕，不宜盲目追高。

translatedData.content:
People on X are saying “ETH has closed red for 7 straight weeks.” First, a correction on the count: based on Binance’s ETHUSDT weekly chart (opening Monday at 00:00 UTC), counting from the week of October 5, this is currently the 6th red candle, and it won’t close until 8 a.m. today (UTC+8). With less than 3 hours to go, it’s still down 14.6%. A red close is pretty much a sure thing, but six is six—don’t count an extra one and then compare it with history.

The real point is that the number of “consecutive red weeks” is pretty meaningless on its own.

From January 19 to March 2 this year, ETH also had 7 consecutive red weeks. That sounds scary, but break it down: the first four weeks were -14.2%, -19.4%, -7.9%, and -5.9%; the last three were -0.45%, -0.92%, and -0.13%. Those last three candles were basically sideways. A weekly close a few bucks below Monday’s open still counts as a red candle. Only 4 of the 7 weeks saw any real decline.

This time it’s the opposite: -7.0%, -5.0%, -3.3%, -2.3%, -6.5%, -14.6%. Not one of them is just padding. That’s a total drop of 33.4% over 6 weeks (2726.93→1816). Last time it crashed first, then ground sideways; this time it ground sideways first, then crashed, with the final candle the harshest. Similar candle counts, completely different situations.

Then there’s the implication that “the bottom comes when the red streak ends.” The 7th red candle on March 2 closed at 1937.10, and the following week did indeed gain 12%, but the low in the first week of June hit 1505.68—22% below that close. In the 11-week red streak from April to June 2022, the final candle closed at 1128.53; two weeks later, the weekly close fell further to 1074.26. Since Binance spot ETHUSDT data began, there have only been these two instances of 6 or more consecutive red weeks: n=2. Anyone using that to calculate the odds of calling a bottom is just telling a story.

My take: the number of consecutive red weeks is a sentiment label, not a price signal. More useful than counting candles is watching whether weekly losses are narrowing and whether buyers are stepping in at the lower wicks. This week’s low was 1711.08, and price is now around 1816. That lower wick of more than a hundred dollars suggests buyers did step in, but what matters is whether ETH can hold above 2000 for several weeks in a row. Betting now that “the red streak ending means an immediate reversal” is the same thinking as betting last week that “it can’t fall any further.”

今年1月19日到3月2日ETH也走过7连阴，听着吓人，拆开看：前四周-14.2%、-19.4%、-7.9%、-5.9%，后三周-0.45%、-0.92%、-0.13%。后面那三根就是横盘，周日收盘比周一开盘低几刀也算一根阴线。7根里真在跌的只有4根。

这一轮反过来：-7.0%、-5.0%、-3.3%、-2.3%、-6.5%、-14.6%，没有一根是凑数的，6周合计-33.4%（2726.93→1816）。上次是先崩后磨，这次是先磨后崩，最后一根最狠。根数差不多，性质完全不同。

再说"连阴到头就是底"这个暗示。3月2日那根第7阴收在1937.10，下周确实+12%，但6月第一周低点打到1505.68，比那根收盘还低22%。2022年4月到6月那次11连阴收在1128.53，两周后周收盘又低到1074.26。币安现货ETHUSDT有数据以来，6连阴以上此前就这两次，n=2，谁拿这个算抄底胜率都是在讲故事。

我的看法：连阴周数是情绪标签，不是价格信号。比数根数更有用的是看每周跌幅有没有收窄、下影线有没有人接。这周最低1711.08，现在1816附近，一百多刀的下影线算有人接，但能不能连着几周站回2000以上才算数。现在赌"连阴到头必反"，跟上周赌"跌不动了"是一个思路。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A Stop-Loss Isn’t an Admission of Failure—it’s the Price of Admission for the Next Trade
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people hesitate to set a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it differently: a stop-loss is insurance you buy in advance, and the small loss is the premium.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn’t who’s more accurate, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The most steady traders I’ve seen are quicker than anyone to admit when they’re wrong. Because they know that whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn’t matter. What matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand trembles as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself:
This is the price of admission, not a verdict.

ETHA’s New 8-K Disclosure | A Governance Personnel Change | ETH Still Needs to Confirm 1850

My stance is to remain on the sidelines with a small position, first clarifying what the filing says before making a judgment on ETH. An 8-K dated November 13, cross-checkable against U.S. SEC filings and the issuer iShares’ official website, shows that the board of directors of the sponsor of the iShares Ethereum Trust ETF (ETHA) appointed Paul Lohrey as a director and member of the audit committee, while Peter Landini resigned as a director on the same day. The filing explicitly states that his departure was not due to any disagreement with the sponsor or the trust over operations or policies. This is a disclosure about sponsor governance and personnel; it does not announce that ETHA has increased its ETH holdings, changed its staking ratio or creation and redemption mechanism, or received new regulatory approval. Reading “BlackRock’s ETH fund has a new 8-K” as institutional buying is a misinterpretation of the filing type.

Why is it still worth watching? The ETF sponsor’s board and audit committee oversee product operations, and governance continuity can affect long-term institutional confidence. But this relationship is usually slow and indirect, and cannot by itself explain a single ETH price candle today. I would classify the personnel-related 8-K as operational information, actual fund flows as fund creation and redemption data, and the coin price as spot-market data—and verify each separately. Farside’s published figures show that U.S. spot ETH funds had combined net inflows of about $2.3 million on November 13, a very small amount, with inflows and outflows across different products. This also cannot prove that the personnel change generated buying in ETHA. There are no new U.S. ETF creation and redemption figures for the weekend, so an old table should not be treated as real-time fund flows.

As for the market reaction, ETH was around $1,823.15 on this capture of Binance’s price page, down about 0.10% over 24 hours, with a range of roughly $1,712.38 to $1,843.15. The price has rebounded from its low, but has yet to decisively break above the intraday high near $1,843. This is precisely why the filing’s release has not produced a one-way move that can be directly attributed to this personnel change. My level to watch is 1850: if price holds above it, then I’ll watch 1880 and 1920; if it falls back below 1800, the rebound weakens, and a break below the range low near 1712 would invalidate the view that the market has stabilized for now. Price action, ETF creation and redemption data, and the timing of the filing are not aligned, so we should not force a causal link between them.

If I were trading myself, I would stay out for now; the only direction I would consider is a small, unleveraged long in spot. I would enter in two tranches using no more than 5% of my total capital only if a four-hour candle closes above 1850, price holds 1838–1850 on a retest, and fund flows show no marked weakening on the next trading day. If price jumps above 1880 without a retest, I would give up on chasing it. The first target is 1880; on reaching it, I would reduce the position by half and raise the protective stop on the remainder to around the entry price. The second target is 1920, where I would close the entire remaining position. If price drops below 1810 on a four-hour candle after entry, I would stop out and close the whole position. If 1800 gives way before entry, I would cancel the plan. If the conditions never appear, there will be no trade—I will not present a hypothetical as a gain.

#ETH
This is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETHA新8-K披露｜是治理人事变动｜ETH仍等1850确认

我的态度是继续轻仓观望，先把文件讲清楚再判断ETH。美国SEC档案与发行方iShares官网可交叉核对的一份11月13日8-K显示：iShares Ethereum Trust ETF（ETHA）的发起人董事会任命Paul Lohrey为董事及审计委员会成员，Peter Landini同日辞任董事；文件明确称后者离任不是因为与发起人或信托的运营、政策发生争议。这是一份关于发起人治理和人事的披露，并没有宣布ETHA增持ETH、改变质押比例、改变申赎机制或获得新的监管批准。把“贝莱德旗下ETH基金有新8-K”直接读成机构买币，是对文件类型的误判。

它为什么仍值得看？ETF发起人的董事会与审计委员会负责监督产品运作，治理连续性会影响长期机构信任；但这种关系通常缓慢、间接，无法单独解释今天一根ETH价格K线。我会把人事8-K归在运营信息，把实际资金流归在基金申赎数据，把币价归在现货市场，三者分别验证。Farside已公布的11月13日美国现货ETH基金合计净流入约230万美元，规模很小，且不同产品内部有流入和流出；这也不能证明ETHA因为人事变动而产生买盘。周末尚无新美国交易日ETF申赎结果，不能把旧表当作实时资金。

市场反应方面，币安价格页本次抓取ETH约1823.15美元，24小时跌约0.10%，区间约1712.38至1843.15。价格从低点回升，但尚未有效越过1843附近的当日高位；这恰好说明文件发布之后并没有可直接归因于这次人事调整的单边走势。我的观察位是1850：站稳后再看1880与1920；若回到1800以下，反弹质量转弱，跌破1712附近的区间低点则推翻阶段企稳判断。价格、ETF申赎和文件披露时间并不一致，不能强行画因果箭头。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向只考虑无杠杆现货小仓多单。只有四小时收盘站上1850、回踩1838至1850守住，并看到下一交易日基金资金没有明显转弱，才用总资金最多5%分两笔入场；若跳涨至1880以上不回踩，就放弃追价。第一目标1880，触及后减仓一半，把剩余仓位保护位抬到入场附近；第二目标1920，余仓全部平仓。入场后四小时跌破1810即止损全部平仓；若入场前先失守1800，取消计划。若条件始终没出现，就是未成交，不会把假设写成收益。

#ETH

The Ethereum Foundation sold a total of 7,500 $ETH over four days, receiving about $14.52 million in USDS. The trades were completed in multiple transactions via CoW Swap. On-chain tracking data shows the timestamps of these transfers spread across several different periods over the four days.

The Foundation is the largest non-profit holder in the Ethereum ecosystem, and the market tends to interpret every sale it makes as a signal. What’s easy to overlook is the mechanism behind it: spending is driven by annual budgets and grant commitments. When and how much it sells follows the schedule of funded projects and has no direct connection to its view of whether prices are high or low. $ETH  is currently at $1,819.99, with a 24-hour change of -0.27%.

The recipient is also worth noting. USDS is a stablecoin, so converting the funds into it locks in the value of this portion of the holdings, earmarking the money for grants and operations. Every subsequent transfer of the Foundation’s remaining funds will be recorded on-chain.

#以太坊 #链上数据 #ETH

content:
以太坊基金会四天里累计卖出 7500 枚 $ETH，换回约 1452 万美元的 USDS，交易经 Cowswap 分多笔完成。链上追踪数据把这批转账的时间戳摊开，四天里落在多个不同时段。

基金会是以太坊生态里持有量最大的非营利主体，它每次卖出都会被市场当成信号来读。容易被忽略的是这层机制：支出由年度预算和拨款承诺驱动，什么时候卖、卖多少，跟着资助项目的时间表走，与它对价格高低的判断没有直接关系。$ETH 现报 1819.99 美元，24 小时变动 -0.27%。

接收方同样值得看。USDS 是稳定币，换过去就锁掉了这部分持仓的波动，钱被钉在拨款和运营的用途上。基金会账上剩余的量，后续每一笔转账都会被链上记录。

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Compounding Positions: Fortune Favors the Bold, or a Liquidation Accelerator?
translatedData.subTitle:
Compounding positions has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a major trend, compound it a few times,
and turn it into dozens of times your starting capital. Today, let’s talk about what those stories leave out.

【What compounding positions involves】Instead of cashing out unrealized profits, you use them as risk capital for new positions and keep opening trades,
It’s essentially using the market’s money to increase your leverage. If the trend keeps going, the compounding is astonishing; once it stops, unrealized gains can go from
dozens of percentage points to zero in just one or two huge bearish candles.

【The mathematical truth】The essence of compounding positions is “being right repeatedly.” If your win rate is 60%, the chance of winning four times in a row
is only 13%. Behind every post you see about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

translatedData.content:
“Five years in crypto, zero returns”—this chart is everywhere. It’s not fabricated, but the starting point is pretty sneaky: that week in November 2021 was right at the all-time high.

I ran the numbers myself using Binance candlesticks. If you went all in at the November 10, 2021 close and held until now (11/16 04:10): BTC 64882→64840, basically 0%; BNB -4%; ETH -61%; SOL -69%. That’s pretty much what people on X are saying.

But many people who’ve actually been in the market for a full five years didn’t go all in on that one day—they bought bit by bit with each paycheck. Assuming a $100 monthly DCA at the open on the 1st of each month, that’s 60 buys from 2021/12 to 2026/11:
BTC average price about 43162, now +50%
BNB average price about 422, +40%
SOL average price about 53, +34%
ETH average price about 2208, -17.5%

With a lump-sum buy, SOL comes last; with DCA, ETH comes last. The rankings flip completely.

There’s nothing mysterious about why. DCA benefits from deep dips. After FTX, SOL’s monthly open fell as low as 9.97. During those months, the same $100 bought more than twenty times as many coins as it would have at the top, so even a modest rebound later pulled the average price back down. ETH’s lowest monthly open in five years was only 1071—it never offered that kind of fire-sale price. At 1820, the current price is still below its own five-year average. And look at ETH/BTC: it’s fallen from 0.071 all the way to 0.028. What ETH holders have really lost money on is this pair, as capital keeps moving from ETH into BTC.

So the accurate way to put it is: if you went all in on BTC at the top, you got nowhere for five years; if you bought altcoins at the top, you lost more than half; if you steadily DCA’d into BTC, you’re up half; and if you DCA’d into ETH, you’re still underwater. Those using this chart to tell people to get out and those using it to call the bottom are both relying on the same carefully cherry-picked starting point.

By the way, the “S&P 500 +62% over five years” figure people on X use for comparison assumes a lump-sum investment. Don’t directly compare it with DCA returns. The figures above exclude fees and are purely based on historical data.

我拿币安K线自己算了一遍。2021/11/10收盘一把梭，拿到现在（11/16 04:10）：BTC 64882→64840，基本0%；BNB -4%；ETH -61%；SOL -69%。这部分和推上说的差不多。

BTC 均价约43162，现在+50%
BNB 均价约422，+40%
SOL 均价约53，+34%
ETH 均价约2208，-17.5%

以太坊市场深度分析：巨鲸逆势抄底与交易所储备创新低

一、价格走势回顾

二零二六年十一月十五日，以太坊现货报价一千八百二十五美元，过去二十四小时内在最低一千八百零三美元至最高一千八百三十美元之间窄幅波动。本周以太坊一度跌至约一千七百二十美元的低点，跌幅显著。在整体加密市场大幅回调的背景下，以太坊表现出一定的抗跌韧性，价格从低点反弹超过百分之六，目前稳定运行在一千八百美元上方。

二、技术指标解读

从一小时级别技术指标来看，综合指标同样发出做空信号，空头因子占比约百分之五十三，多头因子占比约百分之四十。移动平均线方面，七日均线约一千八百一十五美元，二十五日均线约一千八百零一美元，九十九日均线约一千九百二十六美元。价格运行在短期均线上方但远低于长期均线，呈现短多长空的分化格局。

布林带指标显示上轨约一千八百五十五美元，中轨约一千八百一十一美元，下轨约一千七百六十六美元，价格在中轨上方运行，短期波动区间收窄。MACD指标负值持续收窄，柱状线保持正值且相对稳定，显示空头动能逐步减弱。RSI指标回升至五十五附近，处于中性偏强区域，表明短期买盘力量有所恢复。

KDJ指标中K值约五十五点八，D值约五十六点九，J值约五十三点六，三线粘合运行，方向选择临近。威廉指标从负二十八回升至负三十三，仍处于偏强区域。随机RSI指标升至七十六附近，接近超买区域，短期可能面临回调压力。

三、市场情绪分析

尽管市场整体处于极度恐慌状态，以太坊市场却出现了令人瞩目的巨鲸抄底行为。与Erik Voorhees相关的钱包在以太坊跌至约一千七百二十美元时买入了六万三千五百四十枚ETH，总价值约一亿两千五百万美元。被称为七姐妹的关联地址则增持了三万一千四百八十四枚ETH，价值约六千零八百万美元。大额资金的逆势入场显示机构投资者对以太坊中长期价值的坚定信心。

更为重要的是，币安交易所的ETH储备量已降至约二百九十万枚，创下二零二一年以来的最低水平，较二零二五年的峰值下降了百分之四十二。交易所储备持续下降意味着大量ETH被转移至自托管钱包，市场抛压相应减轻。同时约百分之三十六的流通ETH处于质押锁定状态，进一步压缩了可交易供应量。

然而风险同样不容忽视。BitMine持有约六百零七万枚ETH，面临约九十七亿美元的未实现亏损，存在被迫清算的风险。现货ETH ETF的持续资金外流也反映出机构层面风险偏好的下降。九十九周期EMA约一千九百一十五美元形成较强的上方阻力，短期内价格突破该位置的难度较大。

四、热门代币速览

RARE，当前价格零点零一五一七美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之七十六点四，成交量约七百万美元。
TLM，当前价格零点零零一一七七美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之二十八点六，成交量约一百三十八万美元。

📰 Why Is Tighter Stablecoin Supply Making Crypto Market Liquidity Even More Mysterious?

Recent data shows that the total supply of dollar-pegged stablecoins in the market has declined noticeably. Although this change might sound like bad news in itself—after all, stablecoins aren’t assets that inspire expectations of price gains—interestingly, it could expose deeper liquidity problems in the crypto market. For ordinary investors, this means that channels for moving funds may be narrowing, while large-scale fund flows may be becoming harder to see.

Why does this news matter?
Stablecoins are like “dollars” in the crypto world. Their main purpose is to make it easy for investors to move funds between different crypto assets. In theory, a decline in their total supply should make it harder for funds to flow. But the market hasn’t seen any obvious sell-off or panic. Instead, it may mean that funds are moving through other, less visible channels. This could be because large investors and institutions are now more inclined to use OTC (over-the-counter) services or turn to other types of assets (such as spot Bitcoin ETFs), rather than relying on stablecoin trading in public markets. This may reflect investors’ concerns about current market liquidity—or, put another way, the feeling that stablecoins, as a traditional means of transferring funds, are no longer enough.

Impact on the market
In the short term, a reduction in stablecoin supply may slightly increase market volatility, as the friction costs of moving funds rise. In the medium term, however, it could mean that funds are flowing out of ordinary crypto trading markets and into more regulated or safer areas. For Bitcoin and Ethereum, this does not directly mean prices will rise or fall, but it does make the market more complex. Investors should pay closer attention to developments in OTC markets and specific signals about institutional fund flows. Historically, similar situations—such as the rise in the U.S. Dollar Index during the 2008 financial crisis—have pointed to funds moving from risk assets to safer havens.

How to approach the market
In the current market environment, the decline in stablecoin supply looks more like a neutral signal, indicating that the structure of market liquidity is changing. This doesn’t mean we should lose confidence in the market; rather, we need to be more alert to the increasing opacity of fund flows. Investors should pay closer attention to changes in Bitcoin and Ethereum trading volumes, especially spot ETF holdings data from exchanges. These indicators may reflect the market’s true liquidity conditions better than changes in total stablecoin supply.

If a large-scale wave of stablecoin redemptions occurs in the future, or OTC trading volume shrinks sharply, then this assessment would no longer apply; it could mean that the market has truly entered a phase of liquidity depletion.

📰 为什么加密货币稳定币供应缩紧，反而让流动性更成谜？

最近数据显示，市场上美元锚定的稳定币总量相比之前有明显减少。虽然这个变化本身听起来像是坏事，毕竟稳定币不是那种能带来上涨期待的资产，但有趣的是，它却可能暴露了加密货币市场更深层次的流动性难题。对普通投资者来说，这意味着资金转移的渠道可能正在变窄，而大额资金流动的隐蔽性可能增加。

为什么这条新闻重要？
稳定币就像是加密货币世界里的"美元"，它们的主要作用是让投资者能方便地在不同加密资产之间转移资金。如果它们的总量减少，理论上应该会让资金更难流动。但市场并没有出现明显的抛售或恐慌，反而可能意味着资金正在通过其他更隐蔽的渠道转移。这可能是因为大型投资者和机构现在更倾向于使用OTC（场外交易）服务，或者转向其他类型的资产（比如比特币的现货ETF），而不是依赖公开市场的稳定币交易。这背后可能反映了投资者对当前市场流动性的担忧，或者说，大家觉得稳定币这种传统的流动工具已经不够用了。

对市场的影响
从短期看，稳定币供应的减少可能会让市场波动性略有增加，因为资金转移的摩擦成本在上升。但从中期看，这可能意味着资金正在从加密货币的普通交易市场流向更受监管或更安全的领域。对于比特币和以太坊来说，这并不直接意味着价格会上涨或下跌，但它确实让市场变得更加复杂。投资者需要更加关注OTC市场的动向，以及机构资金流向的具体信号。历史上类似的情况，比如2008年金融危机时美元指数的上涨，显示出了资金从风险资产流向更安全地带的趋势。

操作思路
当前市场环境下，稳定币供应的减少更像是一个中性信号，它表明市场的流动性结构正在发生变化。这并不意味着我们应该对市场失去信心，而是需要更加警惕资金流动的隐蔽性。投资者应该更加关注比特币和以太坊的交易量变化，特别是交易所的现货ETF持仓数据，这些指标可能会比稳定币的总量变化更能反映市场的真实流动性状况。

如果未来出现大规模的稳定币赎回潮，或者OTC交易量急剧萎缩，那么这个判断就不再适用，可能意味着市场真的进入了流动性枯竭的阶段。

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Scaling: How to Add to a Trend Trade as It Rises Without Blowing Up
translatedData.subTitle:
If you’ve read the trend right and want to add to your position, how should you do it? Going all in from the start and piling on with unrealized gains makes you a
regular on the liquidation list. The right approach is called pyramid scaling.

【Principle】Each time you add to your position, add less than the time before. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first confirmed pullback,
After confirmation, add another 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position gets, keeping most of your cost basis low so you can ride out a pullback.

【Why the reverse is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn your gains into losses; once you lose your nerve, all your trades go wrong.

translatedData.content:
Rebound after ETH liquidations｜A $16.17 million long position was liquidated｜Watch spot demand first

My stance is cautious: I wouldn’t treat a post-liquidation bounce as the start of a new uptrend. The trending topic on Binance Square is multiple whale liquidations triggered by the crypto market decline. Binance News, citing CoinGlass data, reported that total crypto futures liquidations across the market briefly exceeded $2 billion over a 24-hour period around November 15. The largest was a Binance ETH/USDT long position with a notional value of about $16.17 million. Separate reports also recorded the liquidation of this position at around $1,793 at 20:54 UTC on November 14. This figure is the position’s notional value, not necessarily the cash a trader lost, and one large trade is not enough to conclude that all whales are bearish.

The liquidation mechanism deserves a closer look than the headline: when highly leveraged longs fall below maintenance margin requirements, they are forced to sell. This selling pressure can push down the mark price, triggering further liquidations and creating a chain reaction. The sharper the price drop, the thinner the order-book depth and the greater the slippage. But liquidations also reduce crowded long positions, so a subsequent rebound may simply reflect a temporary clearing of selling pressure. Whether the recovery can last depends on whether spot buyers can absorb the supply, whether futures open interest recovers in a healthy way, and whether the dollar and interest-rate expectations continue to weigh on the market. According to Farside, U.S. spot ETH funds saw net inflows of about $2.3 million last Friday, including $11.6 million in inflows to FETH and $9.3 million in outflows from Grayscale’s ETH fund—a marked divergence within the group. These are figures from the previous trading day, not live weekend flows, and are not enough on their own to offset macroeconomic pressure.

The market has rebounded from its lows, but the strength of the move still needs to be confirmed. Binance ETH/USDT is around $1,824, down about 0.19% over the past 24 hours, with a range of $1,711 to $1,845. The rebound from the $1,711 low is significant, but price remains near resistance at the top of the 24-hour range. I’m watching to see whether $1,845–$1,850 can hold. If price only spikes above that zone and quickly falls back, it would suggest there isn’t enough buying interest to absorb sellers. Below, $1,800 is a psychological level, $1,765 is a pullback level to watch, and $1,711 is the low for this move. If there is a high-volume four-hour close below $1,765 and price cannot recover that level, the recovery thesis should be abandoned. I would only upgrade the short-term bullish outlook if spot trading volume increases, price holds above $1,850, and open interest does not spike abnormally.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now. I’d only consider a small spot long position, with no leveraged futures. I’d place a test trade only after a four-hour close above $1,850, followed by a retest that holds $1,845–$1,850, risking no more than 2% of total capital. The first target would be $1,890, where I’d take half off; the second target would be $1,935, with a trailing stop on the remaining position. If a four-hour candle closes back below $1,805 after entry, I’d stop out. If another wave of large-scale liquidations occurs, the order-book spread becomes abnormal, or price falls below $1,765, I’d close the entire position and cancel plans to add. If none of these conditions are met, I’d remain flat. I would never describe a technical rebound as money already made.

ETH清算潮后反弹｜单笔1617万美元多单被强平｜先看现货承接

我的态度是谨慎，不把强平后的反抽直接当成新一轮上升趋势。币安广场当前上升的热门话题是加密市场下跌引发多笔鲸鱼清算。币安新闻援引CoinGlass统计，11月15日前后的24小时全市场合约清算一度超过20亿美元，其中最大一笔是币安ETH/USDT多单，名义价值约1617万美元；独立报道也记录这笔仓位在11月14日20:54 UTC、约1793美元处被强平。数字是仓位名义价值，不是某位交易员一定亏掉的现金，也不能由一笔大单推断全部鲸鱼看空。

清算的机制值得比标题多看一步：高杠杆多头触及维持保证金要求后被动卖出，卖压可能压低标记价格，进而触发更多仓位，形成连锁反应。价格跌得越急，盘口深度越薄，滑点越大。但强平本身也会减少拥挤多头，后续反弹可能只是卖压阶段性出清。真正决定是否能持续修复的，是现货买盘能否接住、合约未平仓量是否健康回升，以及美元与利率预期是否继续施压。美国现货ETH基金上周五据Farside合计净流入约230万美元，其中FETH流入1160万美元、灰度ETH流出930万美元，内部明显分化；这是上一交易日统计，不是周末实时增量，更不足以单独抵消宏观压力。

市场已出现低位回升，但力度仍需验证。查询币安ETH/USDT约1824美元，过去24小时约跌0.19%，区间1711至1845美元。与1711低点相比反弹明显，却仍靠近24小时上沿的压力区。我看1845至1850美元能否站稳，若只是一根针冲过又迅速跌回，说明追价资金缺少承接；下方1800是整数关口，1765为回撤观察位，1711是本轮低点。若四小时放量跌破1765并持续收不回，修复判断应撤销；若现货成交放大、站稳1850且未平仓量没有异常激增，才把短线多头情景上调。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向只考虑现货小仓位做多，不使用合约杠杆。只有四小时收盘站上1850美元、随后回踩1845至1850不破，才用总资金最多2%试单；目标先看1890美元，触及减半，第二目标1935美元，剩余仓位用跟踪止盈。若入场后四小时收盘跌回1805美元就止损；若再出现大额连环清算、盘口价差异常或价格跌破1765美元，全部平仓并取消加仓计划。没有触发就保持空仓，绝不把一次技术反弹写成已经赚到的钱。

At three in the morning, Xiao Li stared at his phone screen, his eyes bloodshot.

BTC was hovering around $64,974, down 0.66% over the past 24 hours. That drop was nothing in the spot market, but for Xiao Li, who had opened a position with 50x leverage, every dollar down felt like a knife cutting into him.

“Just wait a little longer. It’ll definitely rebound,” he muttered, unconsciously gripping his phone tighter.

Three days earlier, Xiao Li had seen a post on Binance Square from a crypto influencer saying BTC was about to break through $70,000. There were hundreds of comments beneath it, all chanting, “Let’s go, let’s go, let’s go.” Xiao Li had just gotten paid, and he had 20,000 USDT sitting in his account. He thought that if he went long with 50x leverage, a 1% rise in BTC would earn him 1,000 USDT, and a 5% rise would net him 5,000 USDT.

“I might as well take a shot. If I win, I can make back everything I lost last month.”

He tapped the “Buy” button, selecting 20x leverage and cross margin. The moment he opened the position, his heart pounded as if it were about to leap out of his chest. BTC did rise during the first two hours, and his account showed an unrealized profit of 800 USDT. Xiao Li was so excited that he paced around the room, already imagining how he would spend the money.

But the market never moves according to anyone’s wishes.

At one in the morning, BTC suddenly plunged, tumbling from $65,500 to $64,200. Xiao Li’s position went from profitable to losing, and his margin ratio fell rapidly. He frantically refreshed the page, watching the red numbers inch closer and closer to the liquidation threshold.

“I can’t get liquidated. I absolutely can’t get liquidated.”

He added 5,000 USDT in margin, hoping to ride out the drop. But the price kept falling: $64,000, $63,800, $63,500. Every second was eating away at his capital.

At 2:47 a.m., a system notification sounded: “Your position has been liquidated.”

Xiao Li froze. The numbers on the screen stood still. His account balance had fallen from 20,000 to 3,000. Twenty thousand USDT—three months’ wages—had vanished in less than twelve hours.

He turned off his phone and lay in bed, staring at the ceiling. The honking of cars in the distance drifted in through the window. The city was still bustling at night, but Xiao Li’s world was frighteningly quiet.

The next morning, he opened Binance Square and saw that the same influencer had posted again: “BTC’s pullback is an opportunity to get in. Still bullish.” People in the comments were still jumping on the bandwagon, still shouting, “Let’s go!”

Xiao Li gave a bitter smile and added the influencer to his blocklist.

He opened his notes app and wrote a line: “Never use money you can’t afford to lose to trade futures.”

Then he deleted the Binance app and decided to take a month to clear his head.

Three months later, Xiao Li downloaded Binance again. This time, he only opened a spot account and bought a little ETH at $1,824. He wasn’t in a hurry. He would take it slowly.

Because he finally understood that in this market, staying in the game matters far more than making money quickly.
